scrollDown.intro: Swipe down to load more content (feed, lists…). Usually adjust repeat count and horizontal position — keep other defaults.
scrollDown.pauseHint: Wait for the UI to settle before the next swipe.
scrollDown.gestureHint: Ratio of screen height: 0 = top, 1 = bottom. Scroll down = start Y greater than end Y (e.g. 0.65 → 0.47).
scrollDown.directionDownOk: Direction OK: finger moves up on screen (content scrolls down).
scrollDown.directionWarning: Start Y is less than end Y — looks like swipe up, not feed scroll down.

scrollDown.durationHint: Short (~300–500 ms) feels natural; increase on slow devices.

selector.autoFillHint: Use “Pick from screen” or recording — class, app, and match rules are filled automatically. You usually only edit the main value (text, id…).
selector.clickableDescription: Android clickable=true — enable when you need a real button/link, not static label text. Auto-set when picking a tappable node from the screen.
selector.advancedIntro: Most steps only need “Match by” and “Value” above. Open this when the tap misses, several similar elements exist, or you want to review auto-filled filters from screen pick.
selector.technicalDetailsHint: Only edit if you know Android UI structure. Usually leave as filled by screen pick.
selector.chainBlockHint: Use when the main element is only a label and the real control is inside or next to it (often set by recording).
selector.classNameHint: Extra Android view class filter — usually leave as filled by pick.
selector.fallbackHint: Tap at screen ratio (0–1) when the selector above does not find an element.

extract.intro: Read on-screen content, optionally expand “See more”, scroll to load more, then store in a variable or save to a collection.
extract.extractProfileHint: Balanced fits most FB groups. Aggressive scans deeper; Safe is faster and lighter.
extract.openPostBeforeExtractDescription: Tap timestamp/header to open the full post before parsing — recommended for FB group feeds.
extract.openPostPressBackDescription: Return to the feed right after extract. Turn off when the scenario already has its own Back step (default in templates).
extract.openPostManualBackHint: Auto-back is off — add a Back step after extract in the scenario (sample templates include one).
extract.expandSeeMoreDescription: Tap “See more” and wait for UI to settle before parsing — recommended for Facebook posts.
extract.stopIfNoNewDescription: Stop after several rounds with no new items — saves time.
extract.advancedExpandHint: Only adjust if content is still truncated or runs are too slow. Most FB campaigns keep defaults.
extract.edgeExtraDataDescription: Send hierarchy XML to agent-boot for more accurate Facebook post/comment parsing.
extract.strategyVersionHint: Keep v1 unless a newer parser is available.
extract.commentScrollPassesHint: Total scroll passes inside the comment sheet.
extract.commentSwipesPerDumpHint: Dump hierarchy XML and parse more comments after every N swipes.
extract.commentScrollDistanceHint: Screen ratio used for each comment-sheet scroll.
extract.commentScrollDurationHint: Duration of each swipe in the comment sheet.
extract.commentScrollPauseHint: Wait time after each scroll so the UI can settle.
extract.commentNoGrowthBreakHint: Stop after repeated dumps with no new comments.
extract.minCommentScanPassesHint: Always scan at least N rounds before early stop can apply.
extract.saveEnableDescription: Persist to collection after extraction completes.
extract.saveDetailsHint: Collection, tags, parent id — only for custom pipelines.
extract.saveCollectionHint: Defaults to campaign variable '${SAVE_COLLECTION}'. Change only if each campaign has its own store.
extract.saveDedupeHint: Avoid saving the same post or comment twice. Match the extraction type.
extract.saveTagsHint: Filter in the data store — comma-separated. Variables like '${GROUP_NAME}' work.
extract.saveParentLinkHint: Mainly for comments: attach each comment to the post on screen.
extract.saveAdvancedHint: Override platform, content type, labels, or parent link for custom pipelines.
extract.stopIfNoNewLabel: Stop early when no new data is found
extract.maxPassesHint: How many expansion rounds to run for one extract call.
extract.scrollBetweenHint: Scroll slightly between rounds to trigger lazy-loaded blocks.
extract.scrollDistanceHint: Scroll ratio per round (0-1). Lower is safer.
extract.lazyHydrationRoundsHint: Repeat "See more" taps until the UI tree stabilizes. Mainly used for Facebook post extraction.
extract.lazyHydrationScrollDistanceHint: Scroll amount (0–1) for the lazy expansion step. Default 0.3 is usually fine.
extract.prefetchScrollPassesHint: Light feed scrolls before parsing so below-the-fold content gets nodes. Only runs if > 0; Facebook posts only.
extract.prefetchScrollPauseHint: Wait after each prefetch scroll for content to render.
extract.completionRetriesHint: Extra retries to re-expand/re-parse when posts are still truncated. Set 0 to disable retries and avoid repeated taps.
extract.maxItemsHint: Max comments parsed in one extract call.
extract.parentPostIdVarHint: Auto mode is recommended. Use custom variable only for special flows.
extract.noNewThresholdHint: Stop after N consecutive rounds with no new items.
extract.resultVarHint: Optional override target variable. Leave empty to use default context variable.

appLifecycle.stopBeforeHint: Force-stop the app before launching — avoids stale sessions.
appLifecycle.useMonkeyHint: May disable screen rotation lock when opening the app.
appLifecycle.clearWarning: Same as pm clear — removes app data and login state.
appLifecycle.fileTransferHint: Requires agent-boot with U2 batch; local paths are on the machine running the agent.
appLifecycle.installApkHint: Device downloads and installs via atx-agent. Use a public HTTPS URL or an absolute path on the agent host. Supports ${VARIABLE}.

saveExtraction.dataVarHint: Variable name produced by extract step. Example: comments, posts.
saveExtraction.dedupeFieldHint: Use comment_key for comments and post_key for posts to avoid duplicates/wrong links.
saveExtraction.parentIdVarHint: Recommended: use auto mode so comments are linked to the currently opened post.
